gloss: being fed up; being sick and tired (of)

definitions.gloss: being fed up; being sick and tired of
definitions.explanation: The state of being thoroughly bored or fed up with something after too much of it. A reduplicated, emphatic form of {飽|あ}きる (to grow tired of). Most often used as {飽|あ}き{飽|あ}きする.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飽|あ}き{飽|あ}き⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm sick and tired of this job.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{飽|あ}き{飽|あ}き⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm fed up with the same menu every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自慢話|じまんばなし}→自慢話：29001_jimanbanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧{飽|あ}き{飽|あ}き⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ようだ。
examples.english: Everyone seems to be sick and tired of his bragging.

notes:
An emphatic, reduplicated form of ⟦{飽|あ}きる→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧ expressing strong, exasperated boredom — much stronger than simply being a little bored. Almost always used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {飽|あ}き{飽|あ}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

USAGE:
- The thing one is fed up with takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飽|あ}き{飽|あ}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.
- {飽|あ}き{飽|あ}きだ also occurs as a predicate: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{飽|あ}き{飽|あ}きだ (I've had more than enough).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飽|あ}きる→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧: to grow tired of — the plain verb, neutral and less emphatic
- ⟦うんざり→うんざり：04829_unzari⟧: fed up, disgusted — close in meaning, emphasizing exasperation
